edits.before: Late Bard edits fights: R the engage or the objective, Q the chokes, and tunnel the team to the answer.
edits.after: Two-plus items let her Wish and heals outscale your utility — hold R to catch her mid-channel, not on chip.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Drop W (Health shrine) before she pokes — it only heals once shielded, so pre-place it and buy anti-heal early.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Leaving the wave crashing into you gifts free Starcall pokes and self-heal — hold until it resets.

edits.before: Commit on Equinox’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Equinox’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: - Soraka Equinox: matchup-defining — The silence zone cancels your engage mid-cast — step out before the root snaps. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Magical Journey banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Soraka Equinox is 20/19/18/17/16s — the silence zone cancels your engage mid-cast, step out before the root snaps. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Magical Journey banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
